item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-21
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku, solitaire, xiangqi, and a Scrabble alternative called word.
